chapter_title: Chương 225: 0226【Nữ hán tử ra tay, khác biệt phi thường】

segments.title: Chương 225: 0226【Nữ hán tử ra tay, khác biệt phi thường】
segments.content:
In Chengdu, large-scale introduction of foreign-invested enterprises began after China joined the WTO.

Intel, Microsoft, IBM, Motorola, Alcatel, Ericsson... they either opened branch offices directly in Chengdu or set up representative offices or R&D institutions.

Additionally, manufacturing giants like Toyota, Siemens, and Philips also came to open factories or R&D bases.

There were also a slew of banks like HSBC, Standard Chartered, and Citibank, as well as accounting firms like PricewaterhouseCoopers.

By 2006, Chengdu's foreign enterprise ecosystem had basically taken shape, and along with it, an "elite" class based on these foreign companies was born.

The bar owner, Jiang Zhiming, had a vague impression of this guy in a suit and tie before him. He was some elite from Jones Lang LaSalle. His surname was Luo, his first name was unclear, and his English name was Oliver.

Jones Lang LaSalle had opened a branch in Chengdu last year. Since the beginning of this year, Oliver Luo had been coming to the bar to unwind every so often. Sometimes he'd show up alone, sometimes with a few friends. His spending each time wasn't huge, but he was considered a steady regular.

This guy liked to request songs from the female resident singers, and he'd exclusively request English jazz songs to show off his knowledge and taste.

"Oliver!" Jiang Zhiming quickly ran over.

Oliver Luo smiled and waved. "Mr. Jiang, your new singer is fantastic."

Jiang Zhiming explained, "She's not a resident singer, she's a friend of mine."

Oliver Luo said, "I'd like to get to know your friend, which is why I offered to buy her a drink just now." He adopted a gentlemanly demeanor again and said to Bian Guanyue, "Let me formally introduce myself. I am Luo Jun, English name Oliver, currently a senior executive at the Chengdu branch of Jones Lang LaSalle."

"Sorry, I've never heard of that company," Bian Guanyue said.

Luo Jun elaborated, "Jones Lang LaSalle is a British company specializing in real estate transactions, consulting, and management. It's a pleasure to meet you."

He took out a business card and handed it to Bian Guanyue with a smile.

He was a department director at a branch office of a branch office of a British giant. Every time he revealed his identity, he was always successful at picking up women.

A hand reached out from the side and took the business card.

Bian Guanyue smiled.

Chen Guiliang took the card and read it under the bar's dim lighting. "Director of the Property Management Department? So you do property management."

"And this gentleman is?" Luo Jun frowned.

Bian Guanyue said, "My boyfriend."

Luo Jun sized up Chen Guiliang's attire, noticing how ordinary it was. He then waved over a server. "Get this gentleman a glass of Johnnie Walker Black Label."

It was a few dozen yuan per glass. He felt that treating Chen Guiliang to this was more than enough.

Yang Shuo walked over to Luo Jun's side, standing about 50 centimeters away, ready to use a subduing technique at any moment.

Chen Guiliang had thought he was some kind of hoodlum, but it turned out to be a pretentious executive from a foreign company trying to pick up women. He couldn't even be bothered to get into a conflict with someone like this. He stuck the business card back into the man's breast pocket. "You can keep it and drink it yourself."

With that, Chen Guiliang took Bian Guanyue's hand and pushed the guy aside to return to his seat.

Luo Jun was pushed off balance. He was about to chase after them to argue, but Yang Shuo blocked his way.

"You want to fight?" Yang Shuo asked.

Luo Jun paused, then actually turned and slipped away, returning to his own table.

"Hahaha! Even Oliver strikes out sometimes," his drinking buddies teased him.

Luo Jun retorted, "She has a boyfriend."

One friend asked, "What does she look like? We're too far away, we can only see that she has a great figure."

Luo Jun said in a low voice, "Extremely beautiful. More beautiful than that Vivian from last time."

"Really?"

"Why would I lie to you?"

"And you're willing to let her go? You have to win over a girl like that!"

"She's a friend of the bar owner, and there are a lot of them."

"Who gives a damn. A fight would be even better. Just lie on the ground after one hit, and we'll help you call the police. Chengdu has been favoring foreign companies these past two years. Even if a real fight breaks out, the cops will definitely be on our side."

"Getting physical is uncultured."

"Who told you to get physical directly? Find a chance to ask for her number. If you don't go, I will."

"I'll wait a bit longer. Her boyfriend's here, so she might be hesitant. When she goes to the restroom, I'll ask for her number then."

Chen Guiliang sat down again.

Zhang Jie came over too, as another singer took the stage.

Chen Guiliang looked at Run Tu, curious. "I seem to remember you were on *My Show*. Didn't you already sign with a record label and debut?"

Zhang Jie explained, "There's been a change in upper management, so the company is in chaos right now. I had a record planned for the beginning of the year, but they still haven't given me a definite answer. My performance activities have also stopped, so I might as well come back here to sing."

Jiang Zhiming chuckled. "Before he debuted, he didn't have money to rent a place. He not only worked here, he slept here at night too. Back then, his song request price was 100 yuan for four songs."

"It's pretty good here," Zhang Jie said with a smile.

Jiang Zhiming pointed to the person singing on stage. "That's Wang Zhenglian, a teacher from the Sichuan Conservatory of Music. He's also one of our bar's main singers."

Quite a few singers had come out of this humble bar. Next year, after Yisa Yu was eliminated from *Super Girl*, she would also come here to be a resident singer for a year.

The three women, Bian Guanyue, Qin Shanshan, and Tan Weiwei, were now huddled together, whispering to each other. They would occasionally let out soft chuckles, who knows what they were talking about.

Xu Haibo had been listening to the music and eating grilled food the whole time. He had barely touched the alcohol in front of him, mainly because he wasn't used to foreign liquor.

Seeing this, Chen Guiliang ordered him some beer.

After a few cans of beer, Xu Haibo went to the restroom. On his way back, he was captivated by the bartender. Like a curious child, he sat to the side and just watched the man mix drinks.

Chen Guiliang had two drinks and leaned back on the sofa to rest.

It had been a long time since he'd been to a bar. Chen Guiliang felt it was pretty nice, but it was a pity the atmosphere wasn't lively enough.

Luo Jun waited and waited, but he never saw Bian Guanyue go to the restroom. He finally gritted his teeth, opened a bottle of Macallan, and brought the bottle over to have a friendly chat with Chen Guiliang.

"Mr. Jiang, where do these friends of yours work?" Luo Jun asked.

Jiang Zhiming felt a headache coming on, thinking, *Why is this moron back again?*

Tan Weiwei stood up and said, "Director Luo, why don't I go have a drink with you?"

But Luo Jun sat down next to Zhang Jie. "Mr. Jiang, is the Macallan you have here authentic? I wouldn't want to spend over ten thousand yuan on a fake."

"Guaranteed authentic!" Jiang Zhiming said quickly.

Whether it was authentic or not didn't matter. What Luo Jun wanted to convey was that he had "spent over ten thousand."

Usually, when he said something like that, the girls in the bar would listen with sparkling eyes. He wouldn't even need to do anything; the girls would just throw themselves at him.

Luo Jun carefully observed Bian Guanyue's reaction and was disappointed.

Bian Guanyue had no reaction at all.

Chen Guiliang just treated this person as a clown and asked with a smile, "When did Jones Lang LaSalle open its branch in Chengdu?"

"Last October," Luo Jun said, intentionally showing off. "I was a key member back in Shanghai. Last year, I was transferred to Chengdu to help set up the new company. And I became the department director!"

Chen Guiliang said, "A newly opened branch, and you're in charge of property management. The business hasn't really taken off yet, has it? You're slacking off a bit, coming to a bar to pick up women."

Luo Jun said, "Our business is developing very quickly. There are more and more high-end residential communities in Chengdu these past few years. Entrusting property management to an international giant can better demonstrate a community's international and high-end taste. Our property services follow a British management style, which can bring homeowners an experience worthy of the British aristocracy."

"Alright, you've had your chance to brag. Can you please leave now and not disturb us?" Chen Guiliang said.

Luo Jun seemed to be quite smitten with Bian Guanyue and shamelessly persisted. "Are you guys still students? If you want to work for a foreign company after graduation, you can totally come to Jones Lang LaSalle. The HR person is a friend of mine. I guarantee you'll get in with no trouble."

He was trying to fool Chen Guiliang, and at the same time, show off his power to Bian Guanyue.

University students practically worshipped foreign companies these days. Luo Jun knew what his advantages were. He would never resort to physical violence; even picking up women had to be done in a civilized manner.

Who knew, maybe Chen Guiliang would even offer up his girlfriend for a chance to work at a foreign company!

"Sigh," Chen Guiliang let out a breath. "Can you get lost?"

Jiang Zhiming took Luo Jun by the arm. "Director Luo, please return to your seat. Don't disturb the other customers."
